preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The length of the array A for each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**5 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array A must be a positive integer between 1 and 100,000.
The frequency of each element in the array A must be at most 2.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must contain the maximum possible Hamming distance.
The second line of output must contain N space-separated integers representing the array B.

postconditions.expression: all(B[i] != A[i] for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The array B must be a shuffled version of A such that the Hamming distance is maximized.
